## 0.7.7

- A friend's button press is replayed only when they stand near the button (a report naming a far-away switch is refused).
- An NPC run by a friend is given a piece of gear only when it lacks it; every gear update used to add another copy, so inventories grew and unique items were duplicated.
- A settlement piece whose workbench is not loaded waits instead of landing in whatever cell you are in.
- Text from other players shown on the HUD loses control characters and markup.
- A replayed burst still following a friend's stand-in is ended before the stand-in is removed.
- Host: quest stage bookkeeping no longer walks the whole list per event.
- Protocol unchanged: 0.7.0 to 0.7.7 play together.
